blurb: Guests can rent various types of boats equipped for cruising, fishing, watersports, and relaxing on Saguaro Lake. The marina offers boat slips and dry storage for boats up to 40 feet. The Desert Belle provides narrated 80-minute cruises showcasing Arizona wildlife and scenery.
